biggest_catch: Credit is a non-cash one-time bill credit: you get yours after your friend pays their first bill in full, and your friend gets theirs only after paying their first two bills in full; amounts can be changed by Frontier before a referral's enrollment.
catches: One-time bill credits have no cash value and apply only to an active Frontier Utilities bill.
Referrer's $50 credit arrives after the referred friend enrolls on a 12+ month postpaid product and pays the first bill in full; the friend's $50 credit requires paying the first two bills in full.

Referral must be a new customer (not a current or recent-past-90-days Frontier customer) and must enroll via the unique referral link — enrollments from links not generated through the program don't qualify.
Eligibility limited to current residential postpaid customers; government, corporate, and commercial accounts excluded.
Referrer links are personal-use only; referring people you don't know personally or failing to disclose the incentive can get participation terminated and rewards forfeited.
Frontier may change the offered amount at any time before a referral's enrollment and can cancel the program at any time.

steps: Log in to your Frontier Utilities My Account and open the My Rewards & Referrals tab.
Enter your friend's information and send them your unique referral link.
Your friend clicks the link and enrolls on a 12-month or longer postpaid Frontier product.
Your friend pays their first bill in full — you receive your one-time $50 bill credit.
After your friend pays their first two bills in full, they receive their $50 one-time bill credit.
timing: Referrer credit after the friend's first bill paid in full; friend's credit after their first two bills paid in full.
when_cash_arrives: Referrer credit after the friend's first bill paid in full; friend's credit after their first two bills paid in full.
maximize: Fastest honest path: Referrer credit after the friend's first bill paid in full; friend's credit after their first two bills paid in full. Structural blocker: the reward unlocks only after the referred friend completes the qualifying action (purchase, account opening, service completion), and payout follows the program's stated timeline after that trigger.
